title_sq: Tek Rezidenca Orbital Apartaments, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Orientim Dhe Planimetri Perfekte!!
description_sq: Ne Zonen e Bulevardit te Ri, tek rezidenca "Orbital Apartaments" 1, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2 me Planimetri Perfekte! Apartamenti me siperfaqe bruto 120 m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 103 m2, ndodhet ne katin e 1 banim, te nje objekti te ri te perfunduar ne vitin 2024, me dy ashensor dhe shume i mirembajtur. Apartamenti organizohet ne korridorin hyres qe ben shperndarjen ne ambientin e ndenjes me siperfaqe te bollshme se bashku me kendin e gatimit, dhome gjumi matrimoniale me dalje ne ballkon dhe me tualet te dedikuar, nje dhome gjumi per femije, tualet i perbashket i aksesueshem ne korridor, dhe dy ballkone. Orientimi i tij eshte drejt Jug-Lindjes dhe Veriut, cka sjell drite dhe ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites. Te gjitha punimet jane bere nga shitesi. Apartamenti disponon nje garazhd ne katin -2 me cmim ekstra 20.000 euro. Apartamenti ndodhet tek nje nga godinat me te mira te kompleksit-Orbital 1, me fazade te ventiluar.
title_en: At Rezidenca Orbital Apartments, 2+1+2 Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Orientation And Layout!!
description_en: In the area of ​​New Boulevard, at the residence "Orbital Apartments" 1, Super Apartment 2+1+2 with Perfect Layout is for sale! The apartment with a gross area of ​​120 m2 and a net area of ​​103 m2 is located on the 1st residential floor of a new building completed in 2024, with two elevators and very well maintained. The apartment is organized in the entrance corridor that divides into the living room with ample surface area together with the cooking area, a matrimonial bedroom with access to the balcony and a dedicated toilet, a bedroom for children, a shared toilet accessible in the corridor, and two balconies. Its orientation is towards South-East and North, which brings light and natural lighting throughout the day. All works were done by the seller. The apartment has a garage on the -2nd floor with an extra price of 20,000 euros. The apartment is located in one of the best buildings of the complex - Orbital 1, with ventilated floors.
